# Original photo viewer dependencies

The site retains its original Lightbox2 2.11.4 and jQuery 3.6.0 presentation and behavior.
The distribution files are stored locally unchanged, with their copyright headers.

Sources (retrieved 2026-09-17):
- https://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jquery/3.6.0/jquery.min.js
- https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/lightbox2/2.11.4/js/lightbox.min.js
- https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/lightbox2/2.11.4/css/lightbox.css
- https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/lightbox2/2.11.4/images/{loading.gif,prev.png,next.png,close.png}

Both projects are MIT licensed. License texts are in their respective directories.
